Yes—five confirmed bugs:

- **Backend build fails:** current Google Play changes reference a missing `canonicalReviewText` helper. [Code]([project]/server/src/main/kotlin/reviq/GooglePlayReviews.kt:23)
- **Failed AI answers waste the daily allowance:** validation failures retain the full reservation despite known usage. A simulated $0.00028 response kept $0.102 reserved. [Code]([project]/server/src/main/kotlin/reviq/Analyst.kt:77)
- **Older chats disappear after reload:** I completed 11 exchanges; refreshing showed only 10. Earlier messages remain stored but inaccessible through the interface. [Code]([project]/server/src/main/kotlin/reviq/Store.kt:46)
- **Paste fallback can fail:** after entering an invalid URL, “Paste reviews instead” still submits that URL and rejects valid pasted reviews. [Code]([project]/web/src/main.tsx:99)
- **Cleared chat can reappear:** an answer still running in another tab can save messages after “Clear chat.” [Code]([project]/server/src/main/kotlin/reviq/Store.kt:49)

Verified with isolated browser/database probes. Frontend build passed; backend tests were blocked by compilation. I haven’t changed application code or production data.
